Gene-set enrichment analysis (GSEA) was undertaken on the entire list of filtered transcripts, ranked by their t-statistic from Limma, using the GseaPreranked tool in the Java-based desktop application of GSEA v2.0.14 [ 12 ].

Blood transcriptional module analysis was undertaken using the tmod R package on genes ranked by t-statistic; statistical testing for module expression was evaluated using the tmodCERNOtest function, which is a nonparametric test working on gene ranks [ 13 ].
